data.title: Chinese woman held on suspicion of people-smuggling
data.description: SONGKHLA - Immigration police have arrested a Chinese former flight attendant who is suspected of acting as a broker for a human smuggling network that helps foreigners across the Thai-Malaysian border.

data.title: Chinese fugitive with Privilege visa arrested in Phuket
data.description: PHUKET - Police have arrested a Chinese man with an expired visa in a rented house in the middle of a forest on this southern tourist island, after learning was wanted for allegedly running an illegal casino.

data.title: Demonstrators stopped near IMF meeting venue
data.description: Demonstrators gathered on Thursday morning near the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center, the venue of IMF-World Bank Group meetings, but were prevented by police from advancing.

data.title: Phuket to host global Pride event from Oct 28
data.description: Thailand will host the InterPride General Meeting & World Conference 2026 in Phuket from Oct 28 to Nov 1, showcasing its commitment to LGBTQ+ inclusion and strengthening its international standing.

data.title: Phuket set to host global Pride conference in Oct
data.description: Thailand will host the InterPride General Meeting & World Conference 2026 in Phuket from Oct 28 to Nov 1, showcasing its commitment to LGBTQ+ inclusion and strengthening its international standing.

data.title: Key bridge projects due to start in Songkhla, Krabi
data.description: The Transport Ministry is pushing ahead with two major bridge projects worth 6.38 billion baht in Songkhla and Krabi, with construction scheduled to begin on Nov 14 and completion expected in 2029.

data.title: Stranded Muslim pilgrims to get emergency assistance
data.description: The government has arranged emergency assistance for more than 200 Muslim pilgrims stranded at Suvarnabhumi airport after attacks on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh disrupted flights to Saudi Arabia.

data.title: Govt makes first B2m disaster insurance payout
data.description: The government has made its first 2-million-baht compensation payment under the national disaster insurance scheme to the family of a woman who died in a flash flood in Chiang Mai on Oct 5.

data.title: Ex-Dem MP queries couple's assets amid controversy
data.description: Former Democrat MP Sirichok Sopha on Wednesday raised questions over Bhumjaithai (BJT) MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap's asset declarations, citing her property rights in a luxury condominium project and her husband's alleged investments in an online gambling platform.

data.title: Thaksin's lawyer issued warning in amnesty bid
data.description: Thaksin Shinawatra's lawyer has urged the amnesty committee to consider the political origins of the former prime minister's cases, warning that excluding him could prolong Thailand's political divisions.

data.title: Suriya defends B8bn EV harvester scheme
data.description: Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Suriya Juangroongruangkit has defended a proposed 8-billion-baht electric harvester scheme, citing long-term savings for farmers and environmental benefits.

data.title: No-confidence debate by month's end
data.description: A no-confidence debate targeting Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and 17 ministers is tentatively scheduled for Oct 27-29, with a vote expected the following day, according to a Government House source. The actual dates remain subject to discussions between the government and opposition whips and representatives of the cabinet.

data.title: Warning issued in amnesty bid
data.description: Thaksin Shinawatra's lawyer has urged the amnesty committee to consider the political origins of the former prime minister's cases, warning that excluding him could prolong Thailand's political divisions.

data.title: Money laundering worldwide hits $6 trillion
data.description: Corruption can reduce real GDP per capita growth by 3% for up to two years, while money laundering amounts to as much as US$6 trillion annually worldwide, according to the International Monetary Fund (IMF).

data.title: Swiss president to visit Thailand
data.description: Swiss President Guy Parmelin will visit Thailand from Thursday until Saturday to strengthen bilateral ties, promote trade and investment, and discuss regional and international cooperation.

data.title: Southern Thailand braces for heavy rain
data.description: Cooler winds signal Thailand’s transition into the cold season, but heavy rain and possible flash floods remain a concern along the southern Gulf coast, particularly from Oct 23-27, forecasters say.

data.title: IMF chief urges Asean states to do more for the vulnerable
data.description: The International Monetary Fund has urged Southeast Asian governments to protect vulnerable households, pursue economic reforms and deepen regional cooperation to strengthen resilience against global economic shocks.

data.title: Global anti-fraud plan unveiled
data.description: The International Monetary Fund and World Bank have unveiled a global roadmap to help countries prevent, detect and tackle the growing threat of cyber-enabled fraud in digital financial services.

data.title: State auditors query Thai PBS contracts
data.description: The State Audit Office (SAO) has expressed suspicions about the way Thai Public Broadcasting Service hires and pays programme producers, saying it is evading payment rules.

data.title: High-water alert at Khlong Luang Phaeng in Bangkok
data.description: Residents living along Khlong Luang Phaeng in eastern Bangkok have been urged to monitor water levels closely after the Royal Irrigation Department agreed to open the canal’s sluice gate, with levels expected to rise starting from 3.30pm on Wednesday.

data.title: Thai Airways offers new help after baggage crisis
data.description: Thai Airways International is stepping up compensation to restore passenger confidence after major flooding disrupted services, leaving 25,000 bags stranded and forcing more than 200 flight cancellations.

data.title: Family of girl, 7, donates organs and corneas after fatal accident
data.description: The family of a seven-year-old girl from Trang who died in an accident has donated her organs and corneas to help others waiting for transplants, the Thai Red Cross Society said on Wednesday.

data.title: FM Sihasak says Chinese airfield in Laos poses no immediate concern
data.description: Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow has played down concerns over a Chinese airport project in Laos, about 50km from the Thai border, saying it has not raised any immediate concerns for Thailand.

data.title: Three Prachin Buri factories face toxins probe
data.description: Three factories in Prachin Buri have been ordered to suspend operations following suspected toxic chemical leaks that caused water pollution during flooding, while investigations into alleged nominee ownership and “a prominent surname” involved are also under way.

data.title: Deluge by design: Thai villages flooded to protect capital
data.description: AYUTTHAYA - Stilt houses in villages north of Bangkok are no longer high enough to stay dry as Thai authorities deliberately flood riverside communities to spare the capital.

data.title: Chao Phraya Dam discharge rate reduced further
data.description: A gradual reduction in the water discharge rate from the Chao Phraya Dam in Chai Nat from 1,900 to 1,800 cubic metres per second will be completed by 7pm on Wednesday, the Royal Irrigation Department (RID) said.
